band_rule: pass iff low <= crps_sum < high (our value rounded to the paper's 3 decimals lies in the paper's mean ± 2 SD, [0.001, 0.005])
deviations: wandb.entity=novphy (required by main.py; unused when disabled)
lightning.seed_everything(seed) before main (upstream sets no seed)
precision: official 16-mixed on a GPU; fp32 on a CPU (Lightning has no CPU fp16-mixed)
environment: multivariate probabilistic time-series forecasting, Exchange (GluonTS exchange_rate_nips: 8 series, business-day, context = prediction = 30)
statistic: test CRPS-sum (official crps_quantile_sum: 19 quantiles of 100 sampled paths, summed over the 8 series), printed as test/crps_sum by the official test task on the best (validation CRPS-sum) checkpoint
